testsuite.name: com.neurovault.backend.encryption.AesEncryptionServiceTest

testcase.name: encrypting empty data should work correctly
encrypting same plaintext twice should produce different ciphertexts (random IV)
encrypt/decrypt round-trip for large file (>4MB) should recover original data
generateKey() should produce a valid AES-256 key
decrypting with wrong key should throw exception
encrypt/decrypt round-trip for small file should recover original data
